Card Q&A.a: Yes, the purple or red cards with [Imperialdramon] in their names or [Free] in their traits are the only cards that you add to your hand or trash.
Card Q&A.q: Do I only trash a purple or red card with [Imperialdramon] in its name or [Free] in its traits among the cards revealed from my deck by this card's [On Play] effect?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 purple or red card with [Imperialdramon] in its name or [Free] in its traits among them to your hand, and trash 1 purple or red card with [Imperialdramon] in its name or [Free] in its traits among them. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While you have a red Digimon in play, this Digimon gains ＜Retaliation＞. (When this Digimon is deleted in battle, delete the Digimon it battled.)
